LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_WelcomeToHer: Welcome to the HERB SHOP, home of effective and inexpensive medicine!
LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_YouveComeToL:
You've come to look at herbal medicine in LAVARIDGE?
That's rather commendable.
I like you! Take this!
LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_ExplainCharc:
That CHARCOAL I gave you, it's used for making herbal medicine.
It also does wonders when held by a POKéMON.
It intensifies the power of FIRE-type moves.
LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_HerbalMedici: Herbal medicine works impressively well. But your POKéMON will dislike you for it. It must be horribly bitter!
